objective: Prepare source-bound, institutional investor-facing staged website candidates that foreground a bounded evidence-control wedge while preserving research and application boundaries.

authority.scope: local source-bound design direction for staged website candidates only
authority.canonical_website_mutation: never by this brief or a design agent

source_inputs.role: Company-authored platform, HNC and application-boundary source.
Public research identity, catalogue and cross-sector orientation source.
Shared-core application thesis and inspectable-system boundary source.
Dated public research-attention signals with explicit non-adoption boundaries.
Research-led company positioning and evidence-labelled application source.
Public strategic R&D route themes with explicit non-award and non-endorsement boundaries.
Claim-bounded investor narrative and public information boundaries.
No-copy peer-pattern evidence for institutional information hierarchy.

route_plan.purpose: Lead with the evidence-control wedge, then explain the reusable operating model and bounded proof.
Give investor readers a disciplined evidence route without publishing confidential records or funding terms.
Show source-linked research identity, method and breadth as evidence rather than an unsupported commercial assertion.
Frame sector pathways as separately evidenced application options, not as existing deployments or partnerships.

visual_rules.purpose: Make the decision-to-evidence control loop legible before decorative motion or abstract technology imagery.
visual_rules.static_equivalent: A readable, ordered control-loop diagram remains present with all animation disabled.

visual_rules.purpose: Use research metadata and provenance to show depth without treating authored work as independent validation.
visual_rules.static_equivalent: A chronological and source-linked research rail remains readable with no scripted transitions.

visual_rules.purpose: Differentiate reusable method from sector-specific applications through clear evidence labels and pathways.
visual_rules.static_equivalent: A labelled sector pathway matrix remains readable without motion or hover-only information.

visual_rules.purpose: Give investors a concise reading order from commercial wedge to source-bound proof and controlled contact.
visual_rules.static_equivalent: The investor reading sequence stays fully usable as a static document-style page.

prohibited_public_inferences: Do not imply customer adoption, production deployment or commercial outcomes from repository, research or attention signals.
Do not recast public audience attention as independent scientific validation, investment, partnership or endorsement.
Do not publish confidential funding figures, internal company records or private investor correspondence.
Do not describe HNC as an established universal science or an independently validated field.
Do not copy competitor copy, layouts, trade dress, visual assets or unsupported authority signals.
acceptance_criteria: Keep the evidence-control wedge understandable before research breadth or sector pathways.
Preserve every selected claim boundary and link proof signals to their dated source context.
Provide a complete static and reduced-motion equivalent for every material animated interaction.
Restrict staged edits to the exact route-plan paths and preserve canonical website files unchanged.
Retain formal, readable typography, accessible contrast and a clear investor reading order.
Treat any material brand change as awaiting named human visual acceptance and owner promotion.
